Subject:
    Doing (sstatus ttycons file nil)
    when file is already not ttyconsed clobbers the file badly.
    eg, 
    (setq f (open 'tty: '(out ascii tty single)))
    => #file-out-|tty:* *|-70776
    (sstatus ttycons f nil)
    => T
    f
    => #NIL-0-70776
------
Patched.
